nodes.label: Shared lcl media library volume
nodes.rationale: Central ReadWriteMany CephFS media library shared across the media apps.

nodes.label: AudioBookshelf HelmRelease (media server)
nodes.rationale: Config persisted on a cephfs config PVC; exposed externally through the kube-system external gateway.

nodes.label: DiscoveryLastFM HelmRelease (scrobbling service)
nodes.rationale: Integrates with Lidarr (MUSIC_SERVICE=lidarr, LIDARR_ROOT_FOLDER=/lcl/music); reads config from ${APP}-secret; route intentionally commented out (internal-only).

nodes.label: Prowlarr DB ExternalSecret (Crunchy Postgres)
nodes.rationale: Produces prowlarr-db-secret from the crunchy-pgo-secrets ClusterSecretStore; PG connection env is injected into the app.

nodes.label: Prowlarr HelmRelease (indexer)
nodes.rationale: Backed by Crunchy Postgres via prowlarr-db-secret; uses PROWLARR__AUTH__METHOD=External with the dashboard API key sourced from cluster-media-secrets.

nodes.label: Sabnzbd HelmRelease (usenet download client)
nodes.rationale: API key sourced once from cluster-media-secrets and reused for both the API key and the NZB key; reloader auto-reload enabled.
